classification.difficultyReason: Convert the length to centimetres and diameters to radii, then combine two annular ends with inner and outer curved surfaces, all explicitly requested in the task.

content.prompt: A log with diameter 60 cm is 3 m in length. Its hollow centre is 20 cm in diameter. Find the surface area of the log in cm², including the ends and the inside, correct to 1 decimal place.

spec.description: Hollow cylindrical log extending towards the upper right, with annular front end, outer silhouettes, concealed inner surface and rear-end geometry. Both diameter dimension cues are retained; ordinary visible and dashed edges use black.
spec.mathematics: Outer diameter 60 cm, inner diameter 20 cm and length 3 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; supplied working is stored in the answer.

answer.worked:
$3\text{ m}=300\text{ cm}$.

Circular ends:
$$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{ends}}&=\bigl[\pi(30^2)-\pi(10^2)\bigr]\times2\\&=1600\pi\end{aligned}$$
Outside:
$$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{outside}}&=2\pi(30)(300)\\&=18\,000\pi\end{aligned}$$
Inside:
$$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{inside}}&=2\pi(10)(300)\\&=6000\pi\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{total}}&=1600\pi+18\,000\pi+6000\pi\\&=25\,600\pi\\&\approx80\,424.8\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$
